```{r, load_packages}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

packages <- c(
    "tidyverse", "plotly", "DT",
    "httr2", "sf", "leaflet", "gt"
)

# Identify missing packages
missing_pkgs <- packages[!packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]

# Install missing packages without prompt using Bristol mirror
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    install.packages(
        missing_pkgs,
        dependencies = TRUE,
        repos = "https://cran.ma.ic.ac.uk/"
    )
}

# Load all packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

set.seed(1234)
```

# Database

```{r, load_packages}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

#setwd("/home/phesketh/Documents/GitHub/TBSEQ.cat-nf/bin/quarto")
summary_df <- read.csv("sequencing_summary.csv")

# Count of genomes in database
n_genomes <- nrow(summary_df)
genomes_counts <- paste(n_genomes, "genomes", sep =" ")

mag_pal <- colorBin("inferno", domain = 1:8, bins = c(0:5, 8))

# Count box
genomes_map <- genomes_counts |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addLegend(title = "Magnitude", colors = mag_pal(0:5), labels = c("<1", 1:4,">5")) |> 
  addTiles("http://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", options = tileOptions(minZoom = 5, maxZoom = 10)) 
```
